description.value:
Edo Tensei

You bind deceased souls into prepared vessels and command them as reincarnated servants. You gain an Actor-based pool of Unholy Charges, a scaling maximum number of active Edo Tensei, the free Summoning: Edo Tensei Art, and a maximum summon rank determined by Class Mod level.

Unholy Charge recovery: twice between Long Rests, a Short Rest can restore charges equal to your Class Mod level. A Long Rest restores half your maximum charges, and a Full Rest restores all charges.

Summoning rank: D at level 1, C at level 2, B at level 3, A at level 4, and S at level 5.

Weakness to Fūinjutsu: Edo Tensei have disadvantage on saves against sealing jutsu of equal or higher rank. If reduced to 0 HP by Fūinjutsu, they are sealed and must be reconstructed during a Full Rest for 10 Ryō per missing hit point.

Unholy Arts

You learn Unholy Arts according to the Class Mod progression. You may know no more than two Passive Arts and no more than two Ability Arts; Techniques have no category maximum.

Unholy Art Save DC: 12 + Proficiency Bonus + half your Character Level.

Unholy Art Attack Bonus: Edo Tensei Class Mod Level + twice your Proficiency Bonus.

The module writes the current numeric values to the owned Class Mod and tracks Unholy Charge costs from the character sheet.

Unholy Blessings

Unholy Blessings are modifications applied while creating an Edo Tensei. A successful DNA Check grants 1 Blessing Point for every 2 points by which the check exceeds its DC, to a maximum of 5. Each Unholy Blessing Point applied increases the eventual Summoning DC by 1.

The quick creator calculates the DNA DC, available Blessing Points, prerequisites, total Blessing cost, and the final Summoning DC. Blessings are embedded on the created Edo Tensei as full compendium Items.

Kinjutsu Mastery

  • The time required to create or learn a Jutsu with the Kinjutsu keyword is halved.
  • When casting a Kinjutsu, reduce its chakra cost by an amount equal to its rank: D 2, C 4, B 6, A 8, S 10, to a minimum cost of 1.

Memory Feedback

Once per Long Rest, choose one Edo Tensei as your Assisting Edo Tensei. Whether summoned or in the Realm of Death, you gain all its proficiencies. If you already possess one of those proficiencies, you gain one rank of Mastery instead.

You may also claim a number of Jutsu from that Edo Tensei equal to your Proficiency Bonus, including Hijutsu.

Forbidden Insight

At Class Mod level 2, increase Intelligence and Wisdom by 2 and raise both maximums to 22. At Class Mod level 4, increase them by a further 2 and raise both maximums to 24.

Stolen Legacy

After a Full Rest, choose one trait possessed by one of your Edo Tensei. That Edo Tensei temporarily loses the trait and you gain it. You may maintain one stolen trait at Class Mod level 3, two at level 4, and three at level 5. If you exceed the limit, release a previously stolen trait and return it to its original Edo Tensei.

items.name: Master of the Undying — Reversed Summoning

description.value:
Reversed Summoning: Edo Tensei

Within 1 minute of dying, attempt a Ninshou Check with a DC of 28 minus your Class Mod level. The check cannot benefit from Jutsu, feats, or external effects.

On a success, permanently lose 1 maximum Unholy Charge and destroy one of your Edo Tensei forever, taking its place at its exact location regardless of distance or plane. You return with 8d10 HP after a delay of 1d4 turns.

On a failure, your soul is consumed and you die permanently. Each later use increases the Ninshou DC by 2 for each lost maximum Unholy Charge. A death effect that explicitly prevents resurrection or reanimation increases the DC by 5.

Echoes of Past Lives

All of your Edo Tensei count as all Summoning Roles simultaneously: Striker, Caster, Controller, Defender, Lurker, and Supporter. They adapt their battlefield role without needing to be rebuilt.

Effortless Summoning

Summoning no longer costs chakra. You may invoke Edo Tensei as a Bonus Action or Action instead of a Full Turn Action, and may summon multiple prepared Edo Tensei at once up to your active-control limit.

Absolute Edo Tensei

DNA Checks and Summoning Checks automatically succeed. A DNA acquisition is treated as the maximum possible result, granting the maximum 5 Blessing Points and letting you choose three traits plus the target’s clan with certainty.

Whispers of the Coffin

  • Gain proficiency in two skills of your choice; you may reselect them after each Long Rest.
  • When you make a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw, roll 1d4 and add it to the result.
  • Once per Short Rest, ask your bound souls one question as if using augury; the GM answers with a cryptic omen.

Infinite Binding

  • Maintain control over one additional Edo Tensei beyond the normal Class Mod limit.
  • Edo Tensei durations increase by 1 minute in combat or 1 hour outside combat per Class Mod level.
  • You may prepare one Edo Tensei with a trigger and objective. Perform the Summoning Check in advance; on activation it acts autonomously, completes the task, and returns to the Realm of Death.

Effortless Rejuvenation

  • Whenever you spend 1 Unholy Charge, regain chakra equal to your Proficiency Bonus + Class Mod level + Constitution modifier.
  • Treat DNA Check rolls of 9 or lower as 10.

Master of Puppets

  • Once per turn, treat a Summoning Check roll of 9 or lower as 10.
  • Regain 1 Unholy Charge when you reduce a worthy creature to 0 HP, at GM discretion.

Echo of the Fallen

  • You are immune to fear and charmed effects.
  • Whenever you make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma check or saving throw, roll 1d4 and add it to the result.

Instantaneous Summoning

As a Bonus Action, spend 1 Unholy Charge to perform Edo Tensei Summoning with advantage. On a success, the summoned Edo can act immediately, does not count against your normal control limit, and remains for 1 hour in combat or 24 hours outside combat. Refresh its duration at any time by spending 1 Unholy Charge.

Corpse Infusion

As a Bonus Action, sacrifice an Edo Tensei within 30 feet. For 1 hour, gain any of its ability scores that exceed yours, its innate traits, temporary HP equal to its current HP, and absorb its remaining Jutsu Slots as 5 temporary chakra points each. The sacrificed Edo returns quietly to the Realm of Death rather than being destroyed.

Cursed Detonation

As a Bonus Action, spend 1 Unholy Charge to empower an Edo Tensei under your control for 1 minute. At the start of each turn it takes 2d6 unavoidable necrotic damage, but its attacks deal additional necrotic damage equal to twice your Class Mod level and it gains resistance to all damage except Fūinjutsu. At 0 HP it detonates; creatures within 60 feet make a Dexterity save, taking Xd8 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success, where X is the Edo Tensei’s level.

Soul Transference

Once per turn, when an ally within 60 feet would be reduced to 0 HP, transfer up to half the current HP of one Edo Tensei you control within 120 feet to that ally. Excess healing becomes temporary HP. The Edo Tensei loses the transferred HP directly.

Grave Exchange

Perform a 1-minute ritual and spend 1 Unholy Charge to exchange locations with any Edo Tensei under your control, regardless of distance, plane, or dimensional barrier.

Alternatively, when targeted by an attack, use your Reaction and spend 1 Unholy Charge to exchange with an Edo Tensei within 120 feet. It becomes the target and may immediately unleash one Jutsu against the attacker as part of the same Reaction.

Bound Soul Harmony

As a Bonus Action, spend 1 Unholy Charge to link yourself with one active Edo Tensei for 1 minute. You and allies within 60 feet gain one of that Edo Tensei’s traits, chosen when activated. The source Edo Tensei is not weakened.

Summoning: Edo Tensei

Casting Time: Full Turn Action. Range: 10 feet. Cost: determined by construction tier: Standard 1 Unholy Charge, Elite 2, Solo 3.

Bind a deceased soul into a prepared vessel. The module’s character-sheet creator calculates the summon rank, level, ability scores, HP, AC, Jutsu Slots, speed, role bonuses, Standard/Elite/Solo multipliers, DNA Blessing budget, final Summoning DC, and success/failure result.

Failure: charges are spent and the summon does not manifest. Critical Failure by 5 or more: the summon manifests uncontrolled for 24 hours. Success: it manifests under your control.

Command one summon to move as a free action. Each Edo has its own Action and Bonus Action; commanding both costs your Bonus Action. At Class Mod level 3, each also has its own Reaction. Communication is telepathic.

Curse of Eternal Bonds

Reaction, when hit; Cost 1 Unholy Charge. Transfer half the damage you would receive to an Edo Tensei or the invoker within 30 feet. If the triggering attack is a Critical Hit, transfer all damage instead.

Edo Tensei Control

Bonus Action; Range 30 feet; Cost 1 Unholy Charge. When an Edo Tensei is unstable or hostile after a failed Summoning Check, immediately repeat the Summoning Check against the original DC. On a success, regain control. On a failure, the cost is spent and it remains uncontrolled.

Vessel Reforging

Action; Range 60 feet; Cost 1 Unholy Charge. Reforge vessels with a surge of unholy chakra. Creatures of your choice within 60 feet regain 30d6 + 50 HP and immediately end all negative conditions affecting them.

Bone-Crushing Combination

Action; Touch; Cost 1 Unholy Charge. Make two melee Unholy Art attacks. On each hit, the target makes a Constitution save; if both strikes hit, these saves have disadvantage. On a success it is Dazed until the end of its next turn; on a failure it is Stunned. Each hit deals your Unarmed Damage + 12d10 bludgeoning damage. Afterward, throw the target up to 90 feet; an ally within 30 feet of the trajectory may use a Bonus Reaction to perform a Taijutsu Finisher or Bukijutsu with Chain X.

Soul Surge Overload

Action; Concentration up to 1 minute; Cost 2 Unholy Charges. Overload one Edo Tensei. It gains advantage on all attacks, skill checks, ability checks, and saving throws; enemies have disadvantage when attacking it; its speed is tripled; healing and regeneration are doubled; and once per turn it deals an additional 18d12 damage.

Ritual Severance Strike

Reaction when you see a summoning Jutsu within 30 feet; Cost 1 Unholy Charge. The caster makes a Constitution save against your Unholy Art DC. On a failure, the summoned creature immediately comes under your control for its duration. On a success, its duration is halved and it takes Xd12 psychic damage, where X is its level.

Chains of the Death Realm

Full Turn Action; Range 30 feet; Concentration up to 2 minutes; Cost 5 Unholy Charges. The target makes a Strength save. On a failure it is Restrained, gains 5 Sealed and 1 Exhaustion, and may repeat the save with its action. Allies can assist with their actions. While restrained, casting a Jutsu requires a Constitution save against your Unholy Art DC or the Jutsu fails and its chakra is lost. At the start of each turn, the target gains 1 Exhaustion and takes 7d10 Chakra and Force damage. At 11 Exhaustion it is dragged into the Death Realm and becomes your Edo Tensei.

Profane Chakra Siphon

Action; Touch; Cost 1 Unholy Charge. The target makes a Constitution save. On a failure it takes 15d10 Chakra damage and you regain the same amount as chakra. On a success it loses half that amount and you regain none.

Immortal Body

The first time the summon is reduced to 0 HP, make a check using the summoner’s Proficiency Bonus against half the damage taken. On a success, survive at 1 HP. This cannot occur again until the summon has completed a Long Rest without being summoned.

Immortal Soul

The first time the summon runs out of Jutsu Slots and attempts to cast, it may make a Chakra Control check with DC 10 + the Jutsu rank. On a success it casts normally. Each later check increases the DC by 2. On a failed check, the summon is automatically recalled to the Impure Lands.

Immortal Talent

When the summon fails an ability check, saving throw, or attack roll, it may reroll and use the higher result. It may do this 2 + the summoner’s Class Mod level times.

Shadow of the Past

The summon remembers its past. Choose two fixed Skill proficiencies and one fixed toolkit proficiency when creating it.

Imperfect Recollection

The summon gains Jutsu according to its rank. The summoner does not need proficiency in the Nature Release of those Jutsu in order to acquire them.

Former Prodigy

The summon gains access to all Hijutsu from its clan up to its current Jutsu rank.

Immortal Body Realized

The summon can resist death effects a number of times equal to the summoner’s Class Mod level before being unsummoned.

Immortal Soul Realized

When out of Jutsu Slots, the summon no longer makes a check. It may cast a Jutsu at its base rank a number of times equal to the summoner’s Class Mod level.

Divine Talent

The summon gains proficiency in every Saving Throw.

Frightful Power

When summoned, creatures of your choice within 120 feet that can see it make a Wisdom save against your Unholy Art DC. On a failure, gain 1 rank of Demoralized. As an action, the Edo may radiate the aura and force another save, inflicting another rank on a failure.

Unshackled Immortal

The summon’s natural weapons gain +2 Critical Range. Once per turn, when it deals damage and the attack exceeds the target’s AC by at least 5, inflict a condition appropriate to the damage type.

Invincible Form

The Edo Tensei cannot be reduced to 0 HP unless it is currently suffering at least 3 ranks of Sealed.

Inexhaustible Soul

Unless suffering at least 3 ranks of Sealed, the Edo Tensei cannot be made unable to cast Jutsu.

Striker

Melee-focused. Gains Multiattack and can make two attacks with natural or held weapons.

Caster

Ranged caster. Gains additional Jutsu Slots: +3 at D/C, +5 at B/A, and +7 at S.

Controller

Debuff and crowd control. Increases Jutsu Save DC by +1 at D/C, +2 at B/A, and +3 at S.

Defender

Defensive role. Increases AC by +1 at D/C, +2 at B/A, and +3 at S.

Lurker

Stealth and surprise role. Gains the Lethal Attack trait, enabling additional damage on attacks against surprised creatures.

Supporter

Support role. When summoned, increases healing and temporary HP generated by +1 die at D/C, +2 dice at B/A, and +3 dice at S.

Adamantine Skin

  • Gain 10 Damage Reduction against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
  • Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from non-chakra-enhanced attacks.
  • When reduced below half HP, gain temporary HP equal to the summon’s level at the start of each turn.

Ashen Lorekeeper

  • Gain History proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Instinctively know the purpose and origin of any nonmagical, non-chakra object.
  • Once per Short Rest, ask the GM one historical fact about the surroundings as if using Commune with Spirits.

Ashen Trickster

  • Gain Sleight of Hand proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Perform hand seals while holding an object or weapon.
  • Twice per encounter, perform two Jutsu in the same turn if one has hand seals.

Bone Prowess

  • Gain Athletics proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Increase Unarmed Damage by +5.
  • Double carrying, pushing, pulling, and lifting capacity, and double bulk.

Bonegrinder Momentum

  • Once per round after damaging a target, halve its Damage Reduction until the start of its next turn.
  • Once per round on a hit, reduce its AC by 1d4 until the start of its next turn.

Bone Hydra Spawn

  • Gain +2 Reach on melee attacks.
  • Once per encounter, make two additional melee attacks.

Borrowed Discipline

  • Gain one Feat of your choice, subject to GM approval.

Chakra Husk

  • Gain Chakra Control proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Gain advantage on Concentration checks.
  • Concentrate on one additional Jutsu beyond the normal maximum.

Corpse Artisan

  • Gain Crafting proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Gain the Crafter feat.
  • As an action, instantly repair a destroyed weapon or tool by fusing corpse fragments and chakra.

Corpse Healer

  • Gain Medicine proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • As a Bonus Action when using a healing Jutsu, make a Medicine check DC 10; heal 2 extra HP per point above 10, or half that if the Jutsu affects an area.
  • Once per Short Rest, automatically stabilize and restore 1 HP to a dying ally.

Corpse Tracker

  • Gain Survival proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Automatically identify tracks and determine exact elapsed time.
  • Gain advantage on saves against being lost, blinded, or deafened.

Deathmask Performer

  • Gain Performance proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Performance checks in combat force visible/audible enemies within 30 feet to pass a Wisdom save or suffer disadvantage on their next attack.
  • Once per Short Rest, unleash a Macabre Performance; creatures within 30 feet make a Charisma save or become Charmed or Frightened for 1 minute, ending on a successful save at the end of a turn.

Death's Watch

  • Gain Perception proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Gain Darkvision 60 feet, or +60 feet if already possessed.
  • Cannot be Surprised.

Dread Aura

  • Gain Intimidation proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Enemies within 15 feet take -1 to attack rolls.
  • Force creatures within 10 feet to make a Wisdom save or become Frightened until the end of their next turn.

Earthen Juggernaut

  • Gain Earth Release Affinity.
  • Constructs you summon gain extra useful HP dice equal to their proficiency; if inapplicable, increase construct HP by 5 times your Class Mod level.
  • Gain resistance to earth damage.

Flesh Stalker

  • Gain Animal Handling proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Gain the Animal Handler feature.
  • Gain the Summoning Technique Jutsu.

Flameforged Soul

  • Gain Fire Release Affinity.
  • Once per cast, Fire Release Jutsu deal extra damage dice equal to proficiency.
  • Gain resistance to fire damage.

Grave Whisper

  • Gain Deception proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Perfectly mimic any voice and speech pattern heard for 1 minute.
  • Once per encounter, force a creature that succeeds on Insight against you to reroll and use the lower result.

Gravebound Arsenal

  • Gain proficiency in all weapons and armor.
  • Gain +1 AC while wearing armor.
  • Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with weapons and Bukijutsu/Taijutsu with weapons.

Husk of the Forgotten

  • At the start of the turn, if above 1 HP, regain HP equal to Constitution modifier.

Iron Husk

  • Gain +3 AC.
  • Become immune to effects that reduce AC or treat AC as lower.
  • While not bloodied, treat critical hits as normal hits.

Martial Revenant

  • Gain Martial Arts proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Learn one Fighting Style.
  • Gain Extra Attack.

Ninshou Revenant

  • Gain Ninshou proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Communicate telepathically with any creature you can see within 200 feet.
  • Twice per Short Rest when casting a Jutsu, ignore effects that would dispel, negate, or counter it.

Phantom Reflex

  • Gain Acrobatics proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Dodge as a Bonus Action.
  • Take no falling damage from up to 90 feet.

Rot-Eater Savant

  • Gain Nature proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Speak with plants and animals at will.
  • Once per encounter as a free action, call the terrain to restrain enemies in a 20-foot radius; targets make a Strength save and may repeat it at the end of their turn.

Shadow Gale Movement

  • Increase base movement speed by 30 feet.
  • Ignore difficult-terrain penalties.
  • Dash as a Bonus Action.
  • Gain a climbing speed equal to movement speed.

Silent Hunter

  • Gain Stealth proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • While in stealth, gain Non-Detection.
  • Do not reduce movement while stealthed and use the first Stealth check for the entire stealth period.

Silent Scholar

  • Gain Investigation proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • As a Bonus Action, make Investigation against a target’s passive Deception; on success, identify a weak point and gain advantage on the next attack or impose disadvantage on its next save this turn. This benefit may be transferred to an ally who can hear you.

Skilldrinker's Legacy

  • Gain proficiency in three skills of your choice.
  • Gain 1 Mastery in two proficient skills, or 2 Mastery in one proficient skill.
  • Reroll one failed Skill Check per Short Rest.

Soul Fragment

  • Select one Adversary Trait of your choice, subject to GM approval.
  • Costs 2 Blessing Points instead of 1 when applied to an S-Rank Edo Tensei.

Stormwrought Revenant

  • Gain Lightning Release Affinity.
  • Once per turn as a free action, overcharge a Jutsu.
  • Gain resistance to lightning damage.

Tempest Wraith

  • Gain Wind Release Affinity.
  • Creatures of your choice that fail a save against your Wind Release are pushed 20 feet × your Class Mod level.
  • Gain resistance to wind damage.

Tombborne Guile

  • Gain Persuasion proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Ignore language barriers within 30 feet.
  • Once per encounter, force a creature that failed Persuasion against you to become Charmed for 1 hour.

Torrential Husk

  • Gain Water Release Affinity.
  • Extract water from the oxygen in the air; once per turn, count as being near a sufficient source of water even without one.
  • Gain resistance to cold damage.

Twin Pact Invocation

  • Select another Clan. Gain access to that Clan’s Unholy Blessings in addition to the main one.
  • Gain access to that Clan’s Hijutsu and traits.

Unyielding Core

  • Choose one ability score. Once per Short Rest when failing a save of that type, succeed instead.

Voidbrand Illusionist

  • Gain Illusion proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Your Genjutsu gain the Unaware keyword.
  • Once per Short Rest when a creature succeeds on a save against one of your Genjutsu, force it to fail instead.

Wraith King's Stride

  • Move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain.
  • Gain +8 AC against Opportunity Attacks.
  • Your speed cannot be reduced.

Wraith's Insight

  • Gain Insight proficiency and +2 ranks of Mastery.
  • Gain +5 Passive Insight.
  • Once per Short Rest, reroll or grant yourself advantage on an Insight check.

Black Veins Resurgence

  • Once per Short Rest when reduced to 0 HP, automatically rise at the start of the next turn with HP equal to 50 × Class Mod level.
  • When a creature dies within 60 feet, regain 3d10 HP.

Bloodstorm Reaping

  • Whenever you reduce a creature to 0 HP, creatures of your choice within 30 feet make a Dexterity save against your Unholy Art DC or take 3d8 necrotic damage.
  • Once per encounter, trigger a Bloodstorm dealing 20d8 necrotic damage to hostile creatures in a 60-foot radius. Creatures killed are obliterated and leave no corpse.

Bone Crown Tyrant

  • Creatures of your choice within 60 feet suffer -1 to attack rolls and saving throws.
  • Allies in the same area gain +1 AC and attack rolls.
  • Once per Short Rest, become an Undying Tyrant for 1 minute, doubling both effects.

Corpseforge Arsenal

  • Manifest chakra-enhanced natural weapons such as claws, blades, or spears.
  • These weapons deal an additional 3d8 force damage.
  • As a Bonus Action, fuse two weapons within 30 feet.

Death's Mantle

  • Remain under the Blur Genjutsu at all times.
  • Once per Long Rest, invoke Mantle of Death for 1 minute; Critical Range is reduced by 3 to a minimum of 16 and movement speed doubles.

Heating Up

  • Gain the Heat Up Jutsu. Cast it as an S-Rank without spending Jutsu Slots and without its normal vulnerability.

Howl of the Forgotten

  • As an Action, unleash a 60-foot cone. Chosen creatures make a Wisdom save against your Unholy Art DC or become Demoralized and Blinded for 1 minute. Failure by 5 or more also Stuns for 1 round. Affected creatures repeat the save at the end of each turn.

I Must Break You

  • As an Action, hostile creatures within 160 feet make a Wisdom save against your Unholy Art DC or become Berserk for 1 minute. While Berserk, they can only target you and you gain resistance to all damage they deal.
  • Berserk creatures take 2d10 psychic damage at the start of their turns.

Iron Will Eternal

  • When succeeding on a save against Genjutsu, use your Reaction to reflect it back at the original caster; it saves against the higher of the original DC or your Unholy Art DC.
  • When succeeding against Genjutsu, count the result as a critical success. On a natural critical success, become immune to that Genjutsu for 24 hours.

Netherbrand Curse

  • On a melee hit, brand a target with a Nether Sigil.
  • A branded target takes 2d8 extra damage from all sources.
  • Maintain up to three Nether Sigils at once.

Pale Lantern

  • Emit a 60-foot radius of ghostly light.
  • Once per turn, allies within the glow regain HP equal to Proficiency Bonus × Class Mod level.
  • As a Bonus Action while within the glow, allies gain advantage on their next saving throw.

Rotting Dominion

  • Whenever you damage a creature, it becomes Rotted for 1 minute. While Rotted, healing it receives or performs is halved, with the other half siphoned to you and immediately distributable to allies within 60 feet.
  • The creature may use its action for a Ninshou check against your Unholy Art Save DC, ending the Rotting on a success.

Severed Time

  • Gain an extra Action on your turn a number of times equal to Class Mod level + 1.
  • Gain an extra Bonus Action.

Soul Anchor

  • As a Reaction when a creature within 60 feet teleports, substitutes, or uses displacement, cancel it entirely.
  • As an Action, tether up to three creatures within 30 feet for 1 minute; while tethered, they cannot move more than 5 feet from you.

Soulbinding Arsenal

  • Use your summoner’s Unholy Art Save DC and Attack Bonus instead of normal requirements for Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, or Taijutsu.
  • Gain access to the summoner’s chosen Arts. Using them spends the summoner’s Unholy Charges.

Profane Ascension

  • Gain one Trait or Feat from any Class Mod, subject to prerequisites, thematic compatibility, and GM approval.
  • If the selected Trait scales, treat the Edo Tensei’s level as counting toward it.

Blasphemous Transcription

  • Gain one Art from any Class Mod, subject to prerequisites, thematic compatibility, and GM approval.
  • If the Art scales, use the Edo Tensei’s level as its Class Mod level for potency.

Abyssal Reclamation

  • Permanently gain Tier 1 (Lesser) of any Class Mod, subject to prerequisites, thematic compatibility, and GM approval.
  • The GM may limit this to one active Edo Tensei at a time, increase its Summoning DC by 5, or permit later tier progression at Edo Tensei Class Mod levels 3 and 5.

Each trial requires four checks and at least three successes. Costs scale by their base amount for each Class Mod level above 1. Failures impose Exhaustion, temporary loss of access, chakra corruption, or a permanent Edo Tensei Corruption.

Edo Tensei Creation — Vessel and DNA

Vessel: intact bodies have no penalty; rotting or decayed bodies add +3 to Summoning DC; a living host reduces the DC by 1 to 5 according to quality.

DNA Check DC: 15 - Class Mod level. Combat Harvest against an Elite target adds +1 and Solo adds +2. A successful DNA Check grants one Blessing Point per 2 points above DC, maximum 5. Absolute Edo Tensei automatically grants 5.

Summoning DC: 15 + 1 per rank above D + 2 for Elite or +4 for Solo + 1 per selected Blessing + vessel modifier.

Standard, Elite, and Solo Calculations

AC: 10 + half summon level + chosen Defensive Ability modifier, plus Defender role and Blessing bonuses.

HP: (Toughness 10 + Constitution modifier) × summon level. Elite doubles HP; Solo triples HP.

Jutsu Slots: use the rank value plus Caster role slots. Elite doubles all slots; Solo triples them.

Elite: 2 Unholy Charges, HP ×2, slots ×2, one Elite Action, three extra skills or Mastery ranks.

Solo: S-Rank only, 3 Unholy Charges, HP ×3, slots ×3, two Elite Actions, five extra skills or Mastery ranks.

Recovery and Reconstruction

HP: Short Rest restores Toughness × half level; Long Rest restores half maximum HP; Full Rest restores all HP.

Jutsu Slots: Short Rest restores slots equal to Intelligence modifier; Long Rest restores half maximum; Full Rest restores all.

Fūinjutsu destruction: if reduced to 0 HP by a sealing effect, reconstruct during a Full Rest for 10 Ryō per missing HP. An effect that explicitly prevents reanimation requires a new body and DNA.

Edo Tensei Jutsu Specialty

Edo Tensei have access to non-elemental Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu, and Genjutsu. They do not possess Medical or elemental Releases unless another feature grants them.

Edo Tensei is a five-level Class Mod focused on binding souls, creating Standard, Elite, and Solo reincarnations, Unholy Arts, Unholy Blessings, and commanding multiple undead summons.

The creator can clone a deceased world Actor or build a new summon, applies exact Standard/Elite/Solo formulas, validates Blessing budgets and prerequisites, rolls the Summoning Check, spends Unholy Charges, and creates the finished N5eB NPC.

activeEdo.hint: Infinite Binding can raise this by one.
